title: SEKISUI HOUSE, LTD
description:
Sekisui House, Ltd. is a major Japanese multinational construction and real estate development company headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Founded in 1960, the company specializes in residential construction, property development, rental housing, and commercial real estate. Sekisui House operates internationally, with a significant presence in Japan, the United States, and Australia. The company employs over 32,000 people and generates approximately USD 28 billion in annual revenue (FY2025).
